preservation: The original two-human development plan, all earlier automated-judge qualifications and failures, and all existing outputs remain unchanged. No human return is reclassified or fabricated.
effective_scope: Annotation not yet generated for the evidence-calibration redirect and future semantic campaigns only.

annotation_design.adjudication: one separately invoked disagreement-only agent with a request identity distinct from A and B
annotation_design.transport: Codex LB Responses API with no tools and structured output
annotation_design.deterministic_fields: Quantities, units, intervals, thresholds, hashes, identities, and mechanical endpoint derivations remain code-scored.
annotation_design.statistical_role: Repeated agent judgments are measurements within an episode, never independent experimental units.

qualification_gate.exact_task: five-way atomic evidential-support labels, required-unit coverage, highest asserted abstraction level, limitation preservation, and false-premise handling
protected_cases: physically true but unsupported versus supported by visible evidence
recovery chronology versus recovery causing outcome
valid extra facts absent from a compact inventory
qualification_gate.failure_disposition: Retain the failed qualification. Agent labels remain secondary sensitivity evidence or unresolved; confirmation stays prohibited until a prospectively declared replacement measurement is frozen.

limitations: Two invocations of one model family are not independent human raters.
Shared-model and shared-prompt errors may be correlated.
Agreement measures repeatability, not validity or method effectiveness.
